abstract: Chinese state‐owned enterprises (SOEs) serve as critical institutional anchors in supply chains. Utilising panel data from 1076 Chinese A‐share listed firms during the period of 2008–2016, this study examines the impact of SOEs on global value chain (GVC) participation of their suppliers. The empirical results from difference‐in‐differences method demonstrate that SOEs significantly enhance their suppliers' GVC participation. Mechanism tests reveal that SOEs boost their suppliers' GVC participation through operational enhancements, supply chain efficiency and FDI attraction improvements. In addition, this study identifies that resource misallocation and coordination costs negatively moderate the effect of SOEs on their suppliers' GVC participation. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the positive effects of SOEs are stronger for large suppliers and those suppliers without micro and small enterprises (MSEs) as major customers. Notably, SOEs enhance the intensive‐margin of GVCs but have a negligible effect on the extensive‐margin. These findings position SOEs as catalysts for GVC participation, offering policy insights for other economies with SOEs.
abstract_zh: 中国国有企业在供应链中扮演着关键的制度锚点角色。本研究利用2008-2016年间1076家中国A股上市公司的面板数据，考察国有企业对其供应商全球价值链参与度的影响。基于双重差分法的实证结果表明，国有企业显著提升了其供应商的全球价值链参与度。机制检验显示，国有企业通过运营优化、供应链效率提升以及外商直接投资吸引力增强等途径，促进了供应商的全球价值链参与。此外，本研究发现资源错配与协调成本会负向调节国有企业对供应商全球价值链参与度的促进作用。异质性分析表明，对于大型供应商以及不以微型和小型企业为主要客户的供应商而言，国有企业的正向效应更为显著。值得注意的是，国有企业主要强化了全球价值链的集约边际，而对扩展边际的影响微乎其微。这些发现将国有企业定位为全球价值链参与的催化剂，为其他拥有国有企业的经济体提供了政策启示。

title: Do China's State‐Owned Enterprises Promote Their Suppliers' Participation in Global Value Chains?
title_zh: 中国国有企业是否促进了其供应商参与全球价值链？

abstract: Discrete choice experiments are widely used to estimate workers' willingness to pay (WTP) for job amenities under the assumption that varying an attribute does not change workers' beliefs about other job attributes. We test this assumption by embedding an amenity with a known market price, a popular monthly public transport pass, in a large-scale discrete choice experiment with German workers. Many workers, including public transport users, overvalue the ticket by more than 100%, despite WTP for other attributes aligning with the literature. A complementary belief-elicitation experiment shows that advertising an amenity, such as the pass but also common amenities like work from home, causally shifts beliefs about unlisted attributes of the job. Posted wages similarly signal unlisted attributes so that wage variation, the money metric for WTP calculation, is itself contaminated by belief spillovers---such as higher pay signaling heightened stress. These spillovers imply that discrete choice estimates capture perceived bundles rather than isolated attributes, and distort current estimates of non-wage compensation and monopsony power.
abstract_zh: 离散选择实验被广泛用于估算工人对工作福利的支付意愿，其前提假设是改变某一属性不会改变工人对其他工作属性的信念。我们通过将一项具有已知市场价格的工作福利——德国广受欢迎的月度公共交通通票——嵌入一项针对德国工人的大规模离散选择实验来检验这一假设。许多工人（包括公共交通使用者）对该通票的估值高出实际价格100%以上，尽管对其他属性的支付意愿与现有文献一致。一项补充性的信念诱导实验表明，宣传某项工作福利（如通票，以及居家办公等常见福利）会因果性地改变工人对工作未列明属性的信念。公布的工资同样会传递未列明属性的信号，因此作为支付意愿计算货币度量的工资变动本身也受到信念溢出效应的影响——例如，高薪可能意味着更高的工作压力。这些溢出效应意味着离散选择实验的估计值反映的是工人感知到的福利组合，而非孤立的属性，并扭曲了当前对非工资补偿和买方垄断势力的估算。
title: Job Ads as Signals: Evidence from a Priced Amenity and Worker Beliefs
title_zh: 职位广告作为信号：来自定价福利与工人信念的证据

abstract: Authoritarian regimes shape citizens’ knowledge and beliefs through censorship and propaganda. We study which narratives they suppress and promote using a rare natural experiment: Ruwiki, created in 2023 by cloning Russian-language Wikipedia and selectively rewriting its 1.9 million articles under regime-aligned editorial control. We compare the two platforms twenty months after the fork, using within-Wikipedia changes as a placebo benchmark. We find that Ruwiki’s editing patterns resemble professional rather than volunteer-driven content production. An LLM-based comparison and machine-learning analyses of text deletions and insertions reveal a coherent ideology organized around three pillars: Russia’s image vis-àvis the rest of the world, domestic politics, and culture. The resulting narratives legitimize Russia’s past and present acts of aggression, suppress accounts of domestic opposition and human-rights violations, and promote traditional values. Culture’s centrality reveals how authoritarian information control penetrates domains far beyond formal politics, including morality, gender, family life, law, and psychology. Article deletions are rare and confined to topics that are difficult to reframe, while editing is broad, consistent with a preference for reframing existing content rather than leaving unanswered queries: 27% of articles undergo at least some change, 2.8% are heavily edited, and only 0.14% are deleted. Rewriting sensitive topics reduces readability, suggesting that ideological control is costly. An external benchmark using official high-school history textbooks confirms that Ruwiki’s revisions move articles on modern history toward state-sanctioned narratives. The results show how authoritarian information control constructs a regime-aligned account of the world and Russia’s place in it.
abstract_zh: 威权政权通过审查和宣传塑造公民的知识与信念。我们利用一项罕见的自然实验——Ruwiki（2023年通过克隆俄语维基百科并在亲政权编辑控制下选择性重写其190万篇文章创建而成）——研究其压制和推广的叙事。在分叉二十个月后，我们以维基百科内部变化作为安慰剂基准，对两个平台进行比较。研究发现，Ruwiki的编辑模式更接近专业内容生产而非志愿者驱动。基于大语言模型的比较以及对文本删除和插入的机器学习分析揭示了一套围绕三大支柱构建的连贯意识形态：俄罗斯相对于世界其他地区的形象、国内政治以及文化。由此产生的叙事将俄罗斯过去和现在的侵略行为合法化，压制国内反对派和人权侵犯的报道，并推广传统价值观。文化的核心地位揭示了威权信息控制如何渗透到远超正式政治领域的范畴，包括道德、性别、家庭生活、法律和心理学。文章删除极为罕见，仅限于难以重新框架化的主题；而编辑则广泛存在，这与偏好重新框架现有内容而非留下未解答疑问的倾向一致：27%的文章经历了至少某种程度的修改，2.8%被大幅编辑，仅0.14%被删除。对敏感话题的重写降低了可读性，表明意识形态控制代价高昂。使用官方高中历史教科书作为外部基准证实，Ruwiki的修订将现代史相关文章推向国家认可的叙事。研究结果展示了威权信息控制如何构建一套符合政权立场的世界叙事及俄罗斯在其中地位的图景。
title: The Anatomy of Censorship and Propaganda: Evidence from Russian Wikipedias
title_zh: 审查与宣传的剖析：来自俄语维基百科的证据

abstract: The distributive effects of carbon taxation are critical for its political acceptability and depend on both income and geographic factors. Using French administrative data, household surveys, and matched employer–employee records, we document that rural households spend 2.8 times more on fossil fuels than urban households and work in firms that emit 2.7 times more greenhouse gases. We incorporate these facts into a spatial heterogeneous-agent model with migration, housing and wealth accumulation, bridging spatial and macroeconomic approaches. Carbon taxes generate 56% larger welfare losses for rural households than for urban households, as the former may be trapped due to mobility frictions and homeownership. While uniform or income-based rebates reduce inequality along the income dimension, they leave large spatial disparities that must be offset through location-based transfers. These results suggest that carbon policies should account for spatial differences to improve political feasibility.
abstract_zh: 碳税政策的分配效应对其政治可接受性至关重要，且这种效应同时受收入与地理因素影响。基于法国行政数据、家庭调查及匹配的雇主-雇员记录，我们发现农村家庭在化石燃料上的支出是城市家庭的2.8倍，且其就业企业的温室气体排放量是城市企业的2.7倍。我们将这些事实纳入一个包含迁移、住房与财富积累的空间异质性主体模型中，从而融合空间经济学与宏观经济学的研究方法。碳税对农村家庭造成的福利损失比城市家庭高出56%，原因在于前者可能因流动性摩擦和房屋所有权而陷入困境。尽管统一退税或基于收入的退税能够缩小收入维度的不平等，但由此产生的巨大空间差异仍需通过基于地理位置的转移支付来弥补。这些结果表明，碳政策应考虑空间差异以提升其政治可行性。
title: Geography versus income: The heterogeneous effects of carbon taxation
title_zh: 地理与收入：碳税政策的异质性效应

abstract: Financial arrangements involving illiquid assets financed by liquid liabilities are often viewed as inherently runnable. Diamond and Dybvig (1983) show that this is true when risk-sharing arrangements are not optimally designed. Peck and Shell (2003) and Ennis and Keister (2009, 2016), however, demonstrate that runnable banking arrangements can be constrained-efficient when liquidity demand is uncertain and withdrawals must be processed on a first-come, first-served basis. We show that this insight extends to environments in which redemptions are not subject to a sequential service constraint. Instead, increasing returns to scale in banking-consistent with empirical evidence-can generate regions of the parameter space in which the constrained-efficient allocation is runnable. Runnable banking arrangements can be constrained-efficient when the minimum scale required to realize economies of scale is difficult to attain during large redemption events, when the penalty for failing to achieve scale is small, and when the likelihood of a coordinated run is low 1 1 The authors are grateful to Todd Keister, Manuel Amador, and two anonymous referees for very helpful comments and criticisms. The views expressed here are those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect those of the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta or the Federal Reserve System. .
abstract_zh: 涉及以流动性负债融资的流动性不足资产的金融安排，常被视为本质上具有可挤兑性。Diamond和Dybvig（1983）指出，当风险分担安排未得到最优设计时，这一情况确实成立。然而，Peck和Shell（2003）以及Ennis和Keister（2009, 2016）证明，在流动性需求不确定且取款必须按先到先得原则处理的情况下，可挤兑的银行安排可能是约束有效的。我们证明这一见解同样适用于赎回不受顺序服务约束的环境。相反，银行业中与实证证据一致的规模报酬递增，可以产生参数空间中的某些区域，在这些区域中，约束有效的配置是可挤兑的。当实现规模经济所需的最小规模在大规模赎回事件中难以达到、未能达到规模的惩罚较小，以及协调挤兑的可能性较低时，可挤兑的银行安排可能是约束有效的。
title: On the Efficiency of Runnable Banking Arrangements
title_zh: 论可运行银行安排的效率

abstract: Facilitated giving, a common yet under-researched form of cause-related marketing (CRM), involves companies collecting donations from customers to support charitable causes. This study examines the impact of facilitated giving on revenue from ticket sales at an opera house through two large-scale field experiments involving over 50,000 customers. The charitable initiative supported a social youth project aimed at enhancing cultural education and social integration for individuals from disadvantaged households. We found that a particularly pervasive donation ask led to a significant short-term reduction in ticket purchases by non-donors. However, this adverse effect was short-lived and we did not find any effect of the program on total revenue from tickets and donations, neither in the short run nor in the long run.
abstract_zh: 便利捐赠，作为一种常见但研究不足的公益关联营销形式，涉及企业收集顾客捐款以支持慈善事业。本研究通过两项涉及超过50,000名顾客的大规模现场实验，考察了便利捐赠对歌剧院门票销售收入的影响。所支持的慈善项目旨在为来自弱势家庭的人群提升文化教育和社会融入。我们发现，一种尤为普遍的捐款请求导致非捐赠者在短期内显著减少了门票购买。然而，这一不利影响是短暂的，且我们未发现该计划对门票及捐款总收入有任何影响，无论是在短期还是长期内。
title: The Double-Edged Sword of Facilitated Giving: Field Evidence on Sales and Donations
title_zh: 促进捐赠的双刃剑：关于销售与捐赠的实地证据

abstract: The Arab Spring made evident the dangers of democratization of information for incumbent governments, prompting regulatory changes that helped digital platforms gain power. We document a set of political favors (tariff sparing) for US tech manufacturing in 2018, but the rise of platform revenues does not depend on such favors: digital platforms may benefit from tariffs even when they are not protected and their customers are not protected. In an open economy with ad valorem commissions on the tariff-inclusive consumer price, platform revenue rises with the tariff if and only if demand elasticity is below one in absolute value.
abstract_zh: 阿拉伯之春揭示了信息民主化对现任政府构成的危险，促使监管变革助力数字平台获取权力。我们记录了2018年美国科技制造业获得的一系列政治优惠（关税减免），但平台收入的增长并不依赖于此类优惠：即便数字平台未受保护且其客户也未受保护，它们仍可能从关税中获益。在开放经济中，若按含关税的消费者价格收取从价佣金，则平台收入随关税上升而增加当且仅当需求弹性绝对值小于1。

title: Protectionism and Platform Revenues

abstract: Sustainable public procurement (SPP) is increasingly recognized as a policy tool to improve the environmental performance of food systems, yet there is limited empirical evidence on how procurement strategies influence environmental outcomes. This study assesses the environmental implications of municipal food procurement in a rural Swedish region using life cycle assessment (LCA). Procurement data from Östersund Municipality were used to construct baseline and alternative scenarios that reflect policy targets and objectives, including increased sourcing of organic and local foods, substitution of beef with game or legumes, and reductions in plate waste. Environmental impacts were evaluated using the Impact World + method across multiple indicators, including climate change, eutrophication, biodiversity, toxicity, and resource use. The results show that procurement strategies have differing effects across impact categories. Measures targeting food composition and consumption, such as reducing beef consumption and plate waste, lead to consistent reductions across several indicators, whereas strategies focused on sourcing and production methods, such as organic and local, yield more mixed outcomes, with improvements in some categories but increases in others. Substituting minced beef with local game and reducing food waste result in the largest overall reductions, while increasing organic procurement leads to relatively small changes across most indicators. These findings highlight the importance of multi-indicator assessments and show that focusing on a single indicator, or target, risks overlooking trade-offs. The study provides empirical evidence supporting more targeted, evidence-based procurement strategies and highlights the need for improved life cycle inventory data.
abstract_zh: 可持续公共采购（SPP）日益被视为改善食品系统环境绩效的政策工具，然而关于采购策略如何影响环境结果的实证证据仍然有限。本研究采用生命周期评估（LCA）方法，评估瑞典某农村地区市政食品采购的环境影响。基于厄斯特松德市采购数据，构建了反映政策目标与指标的基准情景与替代情景，包括增加有机食品和本地食品采购、以野味或豆类替代牛肉、以及减少餐盘浪费。采用Impact World+方法，从气候变化、富营养化、生物多样性、毒性和资源利用等多个指标评估环境影响。结果表明，不同采购策略在各影响类别中产生差异化效果。针对食品构成与消费的措施（如减少牛肉消费和餐盘浪费）在多个指标上实现持续减排，而聚焦于采购与生产方式（如有机和本地化）的策略则呈现混合结果——部分指标改善，另一些指标恶化。以本地野味替代碎牛肉和减少食物浪费带来最大整体减排，而增加有机采购在多数指标上仅产生较小变化。这些发现凸显了多指标评估的重要性，并表明仅关注单一指标或目标可能忽视权衡取舍。本研究为制定更具针对性和循证性的采购策略提供了实证支持，并强调改进生命周期清单数据的必要性。
title: Assessing the environmental implications of sustainable public procurement of food
title_zh: 评估可持续公共食品采购的环境影响

abstract: In 2012, Kansas exempted pass-through business income from the state individual income tax. We examine the reform’s causal effect on entrepreneurial labor supply using a difference-in-differences design with Current Population Survey and American Community Survey microdata, modeling selection into self-employment with a Heckman selection model. The reform reduced weekly hours among the self-employed in the short run, with the response concentrated among the unincorporated self-employed, the group most directly exposed to the exemption. In our preferred selection-corrected estimates, the reform reduced annual labor supply among unincorporated self-employed workers by roughly 19 to 89 hours, depending on the dataset. The effect attenuates and does not persist. These findings suggest that the Kansas reform did not increase entrepreneurial effort on the intensive margin, despite its stated goal of promoting business activity.

abstract_zh: 2012年，堪萨斯州将穿透型企业收入从州个人所得税中豁免。我们利用当前人口调查和美国社区调查的微观数据，采用双重差分法并结合赫克曼选择模型对自雇就业的选择进行建模，考察了该改革对创业劳动供给的因果效应。改革短期内减少了自雇者的每周工作时间，且这一反应主要集中在直接受豁免影响的非公司制自雇群体中。在我们偏好的经选择校正的估计中，改革使非公司制自雇工人的年劳动供给减少了约19至89小时，具体取决于所使用的数据集。该效应随时间减弱且未持续存在。这些发现表明，尽管堪萨斯州改革旨在促进商业活动，但并未在集约边际上增加创业努力。这是订阅内容的预览，请通过机构登录以查看访问权限。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The effect of the Kansas tax reform on self-employment hours worked
title_zh: 堪萨斯州税制改革对自雇工时的影响

abstract: We employ machine learning methods to identify skill among active bond mutual fund managers. Using a comprehensive dataset of 3,021 unique U.S. bond funds from May 1995 to November 2024, we demonstrate that fund-level and family-level characteristics, particularly past performance metrics, reliably predict future bond fund performance. A prediction-weighted portfolio strategy that goes long the best-10% of funds and short the worst-10% of funds generates monthly abnormal returns of 33 basis points with an information ratio of 27.6%. The outperformance persists for up to 36 months. Holdings-based characteristics do not help to separate good from bad managers. The predictive signal is strongest for corporate and municipal bond funds, while Treasury bond funds exhibit weak performance differentiation. Incorporating equity-side information for corporate bond fund families that also offer equity mutual funds does not enhance predictive performance.
abstract_zh: 我们采用机器学习方法识别主动型债券共同基金经理的选股能力。基于1995年5月至2024年11月期间涵盖3021只美国债券基金的全面数据集，研究表明基金层面与家族层面的特征（尤其是历史业绩指标）能够可靠预测债券基金的未来表现。采用预测加权组合策略（做多表现最佳的前10%基金，做空表现最差的后10%基金），每月可获得33个基点的异常收益，信息比率达27.6%。这种超额收益可持续长达36个月。基于持仓的特征无法有效区分优秀与平庸的基金经理。预测信号在公司和市政债券基金中最为显著，而国债基金的业绩分化较弱。对于同时提供股票型共同基金的企业债券基金家族，纳入股票端信息并未提升预测效果。
title: Detecting Skilled Bond Fund Managers
title_zh: 识别熟练债券基金经理人

abstract: Urban Land-use Planning Regulations (ULPR) are key instruments for implementing urban planning policies. They shape the form and function of urban areas by defining zoning categories as well as building-form and building-function constraints. Their integration into 3D Urban Land-Use Simulation (ULUS) is therefore essential for producing realistic and policy-informed outputs. However, ULPR vary widely across municipalities and countries, and methods for their systematic integration into 3D ULUS remain limited. This study develops a conceptual framework to transform local ULPR into a standardized structure and enhance their applicability in 3D ULUS. The framework establishes a unified classification system for zoning categories and defines standardized building-form and building-function characteristics, specifying what is regulated and how these regulations are applied. Using policy instrument theory, the framework further systematizes approaches to formulating ULPR such as prescriptive, performance-based, or hybrid. Finally, it enables 3D simulations of urban land use governed by ULPR. To demonstrate its applicability, the framework was tested in two European cities, Zurich (Switzerland) and Copenhagen (Denmark), by converting their local ULPR into a standardized format and applying them in 3D ULUS. The results demonstrate that the standardization ensures consistency across jurisdictions and facilitates the integration of ULPR in 3D ULUS. The applications further highlight the framework’s adaptability across different regulatory systems, while also revealing challenges in aggregating detailed zoning categories and translating context-dependent ULPR into comparable characteristics. By providing a structured and adaptable framework, this study supports data interoperability and comparable studies, enabling more policy-relevant analyses of land-use changes.
abstract_zh: 城市土地利用规划法规（ULPR）是实施城市规划政策的关键工具。它们通过界定分区类别以及建筑形态与建筑功能约束，塑造城市区域的形式与功能。因此，将其整合至三维城市土地利用模拟（ULUS）中，对于生成符合现实且具有政策依据的输出结果至关重要。然而，不同城市和国家之间的ULPR差异显著，且系统化整合至三维ULUS的方法仍十分有限。本研究构建了一个概念框架，旨在将地方ULPR转化为标准化结构，并增强其在三维ULUS中的适用性。该框架建立了统一的分区类别分类体系，定义了标准化的建筑形态与建筑功能特征，明确了受规制内容及规制实施方式。基于政策工具理论，该框架进一步系统化了ULPR的制定方法，如规范性、绩效导向或混合型方法。最终，该框架实现了受ULPR约束的城市土地利用三维模拟。为验证其适用性，研究在苏黎世（瑞士）和哥本哈根（丹麦）两座欧洲城市进行了测试，将其地方ULPR转换为标准化格式并应用于三维ULUS。结果表明，标准化确保了跨司法管辖区的统一性，并促进了ULPR在三维ULUS中的整合。应用案例进一步凸显了该框架在不同监管体系下的适应性，同时也揭示了在聚合详细分区类别及将情境依赖型ULPR转化为可比特征时面临的挑战。通过提供结构化且适应性强的框架，本研究支持了数据互操作性与可比性研究，从而推动更具政策相关性的土地利用变化分析。
title: Toward policy-informed 3D urban land-use simulations by leveraging urban planning regulations: Case studies in Zurich and Copenhagen
title_zh: 利用城市规划法规实现政策导向的三维城市土地利用模拟：苏黎世与哥本哈根案例研究

abstract: Accurate estimates of food and nutrient elasticities are important inputs for the design of efficient policies targeting the poor. In this paper we estimate the expenditure elasticity of food and calories using exogenous variation in budget from two unconditional cash transfer programs in rural Kenya, combined with detailed data on food expenditure, nutrition and prices. We find an elasticity of food expenditure of 0.86 and of calories of 0.66. Although these estimates are higher than those reported in many previous studies — plausibly because our study focuses on extremely poor households — they are significantly lower than those obtained using a non-experimental analysis in our context.
abstract_zh: 准确估计食物和营养弹性是设计针对贫困人口的有效政策的重要依据。本文利用肯尼亚农村地区两项无条件现金转移项目带来的预算外生变化，结合详细的食品支出、营养和价格数据，估算了食品和卡路里的支出弹性。研究发现，食品支出弹性为0.86，卡路里弹性为0.66。尽管这些估计值高于许多先前研究报告的结果——可能因为本研究聚焦于极端贫困家庭——但它们显著低于在本研究情境下通过非实验分析所得出的数值。
title: The expenditure elasticity for food and calories: Evidence from unconditional cash transfers in Kenya
title_zh: 食品与卡路里的支出弹性：来自肯尼亚无条件现金转移支付的证据
